title: Running Overlay Component v0.1
description: Declarative overlay component format. See docs/overlay-components/spec-v0.1.md.

alignSelf.description: Only valid on a direct stack child.

spacerNode.description: Only valid as a stack child; takes no frame.

runningGaugeNode.description: Host-drawn activity dial. Data formatting and drawing stay host-owned; this node supplies appearance and region metrics.

distanceTimelineNode.description: Host-drawn distance progress track. Distance text, axis labels and stats bar stay host-owned.

elevationChartNode.description: Host-drawn elevation profile. Sample series, smoothing and labels stay host-owned.

routeMapNode.description: Host-drawn projected GPS route. Projection, map snapshots and stats bar stay host-owned.

weatherWidgetNode.description: Host-drawn weather card. The host supplies the weather snapshot and icon assets; the component never fetches weather.
